Question: I want to know Is Hajj now obligatory on me. My financial condiotion as follows. last year on hajj occasion, i did not have much saving but this year i can bear all expenses of Hajj for both me and my wife insha Allah. some thing which is confusing me is, i live with my parents in their home along with my two younger borthers, it wont be enough if my next (second) brother gets married which is expected soon, also will become un conformtable when me or my brother got kids. shal i contruct home on the extended land or go for hajj this year? Answer ID: 14585 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1119/913=L/1430) You should perform hajj first, it is not better to delay hajj when it is already due on you. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
